test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "influence."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence suggests that individual coping qualities affect the behavior of stressful drivers.
 
• Therefore, the word that best fits in the blank and maintains the intended meaning is** "influence,"** as it indicates the impact or effect of individual coping qualities on the behavior of drivers. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु में परिवर्तन लाने के लिए उस पर प्रभाव या शक्ति का उपयोग करना)

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Correct paragraph:

All drivers are affected by road rage, whether they are directly or indirectly involved__ Individual coping qualities __**influence**__ the behaviour of stressful drivers. Instead of being enraged over circumstances beyond their control, drivers ______ (3) _______ learn to be patient. On the road, we must be ______ (4) ______ to control our own emotions. Road raged drivers are also more likely to ______ (5) _______ more traffic offences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Increase: **to become or to make something larger in number or amount. (संख्‍या या मात्रा में वृद्धि होना या करना, संख्‍या या मात्रा की दृष्टि से बढ़ना या बढ़ाना)
 
• **Apply: **to ask for something in writing. (लिखित माँग करना, आवेदन करना)
 
• **Multiply: **to increase a number by the number of times mentioned. (किसी अंक को निर्दिष्ट संख्‍या से गुणा करना)
